newsitem.title: INDIA: MCN to pay $56 mln for stake in Torrent.
newsitem.headline: MCN to pay $56 mln for stake in Torrent.

text.p: U.S.-based MCN Corp will pay $56 million for its 40 percent equity stake in Torrent Power, the Indian company said on Thursday.
"MCN is initially investing approximately $56 million in return for 40 percent equity in Torrent Power," a company statement said.
Torrent Group said earlier on Thursday that MCN was buying a 40 percent equity stake in Torrent Power.
Torrent is a large diversified group with extensive operations in health care, energy and financial sectors.
MCN is a $3.6 billion energy company having global investments with a special thrust in North America.
